basis: Explicit user correction: sending new work/context to browser sessions already started does not work.
rules: Every fresh browser session starts with one complete immutable input packet: exact source SHAs, full assigned criteria and contracts, exclusive write paths, lease, complete output, validation responsibility and consumer.
Do not count a GitHub comment, edited instruction file or review request as context delivered to an already-started browser session. No wake, runtime ACK or receipt is implied.
Do not enlarge an in-flight session's mission by sending later source outputs. Its original packet remains the work boundary. Previously authorized autonomous work within that packet continues.

S0 verifies new terminal outputs and appends them to a frozen next-batch manifest. A fresh integration or validation session receives the complete batch only at startup, after sole-writer/dispatcher transfer is verified. Do not wait for all campaign work if a complete independent batch is ready.

Findings and source deliveries are durable outputs for the next relevant fresh session, not messages presumed received by current authors. A correction needs a fresh mission with exact failing input when its original session has already started or ended.
Active sessions may independently finish their originally assigned work and publish complete PR/handoff. No recycled chats, no duplicate supervisor, no concurrent product writer or CI dispatcher.
State transitions are SOURCE_READY -> BATCH_PREPARED -> FRESH_CONSUMER_ACK -> CONSUMED -> VALIDATED. GitHub notices remain NOTICE_ONLY and never satisfy any transition.

Prior comments remain historical notices; do not delete or misrepresent them. Prior pinned packets/plans remain immutable; this operational delta changes dispatch/delivery semantics, not product scope or release criteria.
